text: Do the trees in a forest feed each other?
If there is an answer, it is down here.
A tree's finest roots are wrapped in fungus,
threads far thinner than a hair.
The tree pays the fungus in sugar, made from sunlight.
The fungus pays back in water and nutrients from the soil.
And the same fungus can reach the next tree.
Whether trees pass food along it is still argued over.
asr: Weather trees pass food along it is still argued over.

text: But one thing is clear. No tree grows alone.
